name: strait-of-hormuz-crisis-data
title: Strait of Hormuz Crisis Data
description: Open, daily-refreshed time series behind straits.live, the real-time Strait of Hormuz crisis monitor: IMF PortWatch daily transit counts, the composite Hormuz Index (Crisis Pressure and Escalation Forecast), Brent and WTI futures prices, an indexed event log, and the live status snapshot.

resources.name: transits
resources.title: Daily transit counts
resources.description: Daily vessel-transit counts through the Strait of Hormuz from IMF PortWatch. The series the major prediction-market reopening contracts resolve on, via its 7-day moving average against a 60-transit threshold.

licenses.name: other
licenses.title: Free to use; underlying data (c) IMF PortWatch, cite IMF PortWatch when republishing

resources.name: hormuz-index
resources.title: Hormuz Index history (5-minute)
resources.description: The two composite 0-100 indices at 5-minute resolution for the last 7 days. Versioned methodology at https://straits.live/methodology.

fields.name: methodology_version
fields.title: Methodology version the reading was computed under (see https://straits.live/methodology/changelog)

resources.name: hormuz-index-daily
resources.title: Hormuz Index daily rollup
resources.description: Daily open/high/low/close/mean rollup of both index composites, full history.

fields.name: crisis_band
fields.title: Closing band label for Crisis Pressure

fields.name: forecast_band
fields.title: Closing band label for Escalation Forecast

fields.name: methodology_version
fields.title: Methodology version the day ran under; a day that straddled a methodology change lists both versions, oldest first, e.g. 0.7.1>0.7.2

resources.name: oil
resources.title: Brent and WTI futures prices
resources.description: Timestamped Brent and WTI front-month futures prices, sampled best-effort hourly since 2026-05-05, with gaps over weekends and whenever the collector is offline. Each row names its delivery-month contract in brent_symbol and wti_symbol.

fields.name: brent_usd
fields.title: Brent crude front-month futures price, USD per barrel

fields.name: wti_usd
fields.title: WTI crude front-month futures price, USD per barrel

fields.name: brent_symbol
fields.title: Delivery-month contract the Brent price came from, e.g. BZU26.NYM; blank on rows older than the field. Compare consecutive rows to tell a contract roll from a market move

fields.name: wti_symbol
fields.title: Delivery-month contract the WTI price came from, e.g. CLU26.NYM; blank on rows older than the field

resources.name: events
resources.title: Crisis event log
resources.description: Indexed strikes, ship incidents, closures, and diplomatic developments, each with a cited source URL.

licenses.name: other
licenses.title: Free to use; per-row sources cited inline

fields.name: type
fields.title: Event class: strike, ship_incident, closure, or negotiation

resources.name: status
resources.title: Live status snapshot
resources.description: One-row snapshot of the current dashboard state. Re-poll on a schedule to build your own history. Column order is a stable contract; new columns are appended. Brent and WTI here are front-month futures, except when the futures feed is down; brent_basis says which.

fields.name: brent_usd
fields.title: Brent front-month futures price, USD per barrel. While the futures feed has been stale for over 2 hours it carries the EIA daily spot close instead; brent_basis says which

fields.name: wti_usd
fields.title: WTI front-month futures price, USD per barrel. Carries the EIA daily spot close in the same cases as brent_usd

fields.name: brent_change_source
fields.title: How brent_change_24h_pct was measured: 'trailing-24h', 'prev-close' or 'frozen-weekend'. Only 'trailing-24h' is a literal 24 hours

fields.name: transits_asof_date
fields.title: Date of the newest IMF PortWatch row behind transits_count (UTC)

fields.name: transits_asof_age_days
fields.title: Age of transits_asof_date in days, relative to today

fields.name: transits_stale
fields.title: True when transits_count comes from PortWatch and that data is older than the site's staleness limit

fields.name: ships_stranded
fields.title: All-waters rollup of vessels held in the region: every vessel seen holding position in the strait window, including ships at berth at regional ports

fields.name: ships_basis
fields.title: Counting basis for the ships_* columns, e.g. 'tiled12-active30m-fix60': a vessel counts only if sighted in the last 30 minutes and its position fix is not stale. The basis changed on 2026-07-20, 2026-07-30 and 2026-09-26, so the ships_* series has breaks at those dates

fields.name: carriers_hormuz_stopped
fields.title: Count of carriers whose Hormuz posture is 'stopped', whatever the age of the advisory. carriers_suspended is always 0, so use this column instead

fields.name: carriers_hormuz_stopped_current
fields.title: Of carriers_hormuz_stopped, the carriers whose own advisory is 60 days old or less; the count the site's open/closed verdict uses

fields.name: tehran_rate_basis
fields.title: How tehran_toman_per_usd was obtained: 'direct' is a quoted dollar rate, 'cross-aed' is implied from the UAE dirham rate at the 3.6725 peg because the source is not quoting the dollar

fields.name: transits_provisional
fields.title: True while the newest PortWatch row is within 3 days of today and can still be revised on the next publish

fields.name: transits_ma7
fields.title: 7-day mean of daily transits ending on transits_asof_date; empty when those 7 days are not contiguous

fields.name: ships_stranded_offshore
fields.title: Subset of ships_stranded waiting offshore: leaves out vessels within 25 km of a working port. The figure the site's own text uses

fields.name: brent_basis
fields.title: What brent_usd and wti_usd are: 'futures' (front-month futures) or 'eia-spot' (EIA daily spot close, used as a backstop when the futures feed is down; a different instrument that can sit $20 or more above futures). Empty when there is no Brent value
